name: (04) Thaumaturgy (Path of Blood) — 2 Intermediate — Theft of Vitae

system.description:
Answering the call of blood, the sorcerer draws the vitae straight from a distant victim's body, blood bursting from their pores to soar through the air and sink into the caster's flesh.

You must see your target within 50 feet, with no intervening barrier. Expend a number of Mental Traits equal to the blood you wish to steal, up to a maximum of three, then win a challenge of your Mental Traits against the subject's Physical Traits to tear forth that many Blood Traits (limited by their actual blood). Stolen vitae carries all its normal properties, so three drinks still create a blood bond and poisoned blood still sickens you. Using it in public is a breach of the Masquerade. Retest with Occult.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
